categories.main_business_segments: Windey Energy Technology Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: wind turbine equipment manufacturing, clean energy development and operation, and new energy engineering general contracting. Additionally, the company is expanding into strategic emerging businesses including energy storage system solutions, integrated energy services, and new energy consumption. The company aims to build a comprehensive business ecosystem integrating six major sectors centered on new energy and carbon emission management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in wind turbine technology with proprietary core control strategies and independent intellectual property rights. It employs a manufacturing model combining complete assembly with specialized component collaboration, ensuring quality control over supplier-produced parts. The company focuses on large-scale, intelligent, and high-end wind turbines, including offshore platforms and advanced energy storage technologies such as intelligent liquid-cooled container systems and battery management systems. It also develops AI-based blade quality monitoring and digital platforms for wind farm design and power forecasting.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include central and state-owned enterprises, with a growing international client base in Asia, Europe, South America, and Africa. The company serves wind power developers, operators, and EPC contractors, focusing on large-scale wind power bases in northern China, offshore wind markets, and emerging international markets such as the Middle East and North Africa. Its products and services cater to wind farm construction, operation, and maintenance, as well as integrated energy solutions for diverse market needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant activities in northern regions such as Inner Mongolia, Gansu, Xinjiang, and Qinghai, as well as coastal provinces for offshore wind development. It has expanded its international footprint to over 20 countries and regions, including the Middle East, Southeast Asia, South America, and Africa. The company maintains R&D centers and innovation institutes domestically and in Europe to support global operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Windey operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the wind energy supply chain, focusing on wind turbine design, manufacturing, assembly, and wind farm construction and operation. It extends its supply chain involvement through strategic investments in key components like blades to ensure cost control and supply security. The company also provides integrated solutions encompassing project development, EPC services, and energy storage systems, positioning itself as a comprehensive new energy service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in large-scale, intelligent, and high-reliability wind turbines, including offshore and deep-sea platforms. It invests in AI-driven quality control, digital wind farm design, and power forecasting platforms. R&D efforts also focus on energy storage technologies, such as liquid-cooled battery systems and vanadium flow batteries. The company aims to enhance its global competitiveness by developing products tailored to diverse regional markets and advancing integrated energy solutions and new energy consumption scenarios like green hydrogen and methanol.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of wind turbine equipment, clean energy power generation, and new energy engineering contracting services. The company also earns income from the development, operation, and transfer of renewable energy power stations. Additional revenue streams include energy storage system sales and services, integrated energy services, and green energy consumption solutions. The company operates mainly on a direct sales model with project-based contracts and long-term asset holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Windey is positioned as one of the leading domestic wind turbine manufacturers in China with advanced technology and a strong market presence. It competes with other major Chinese and international wind turbine manufacturers in both onshore and offshore markets. The company emphasizes product reliability, efficiency, and comprehensive service capabilities to maintain and grow its market share amid increasing industry concentration and competition. Its accelerated international expansion and diversified business model enhance its competitive positioning.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 22.2 billion, a year-on-year increase of 18.54%, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 464.8 million, up 12.24%. The company achieved a 37.22% increase in wind turbine sales volume to 11,618 MW and secured new orders totaling 30,893 MW, nearly doubling year-over-year. Total assets reached RMB 38.7 billion, growing 12.22% from the previous year. The company maintains positive cash flow from operations and continues to expand its subsidiary base and international market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Windey emphasizes its technological leadership with proprietary core control strategies and a comprehensive product portfolio tailored to diverse market needs, including large-scale and intelligent wind turbines for onshore and offshore applications. The company offers integrated solutions covering the full lifecycle of wind power projects, from resource assessment to operation and maintenance, enhancing customer value. Its commitment to innovation, quality, and internationalization, combined with strategic supply chain integration and emerging business development in energy storage and green energy consumption, differentiates it as a modern, competitive new energy service provider.
